trigger.offline_threshold: offline AK4 HT > 1100 GeV (plus both AK8 pT>250); efficiency of the OR vs reference HLT_PFJet260: 0.9957 (CP 68% 0.9956-0.9959), 140442 ref events, target 0.99
trigger.method: orthogonal reference trigger HLT_PFJet260 (cross-check HLT_AK8PFJet260), Clopper-Pearson; offline selection in denominator; MC: no trigger applied, HT>1100 cut only; PFHT800 not used (absent in era H)

preselection: two leading AK8 jets: pT>250 GeV, |eta|<2.4, jetId>=2

independence.method: QCD-MC kappa=AD/(BC) scan of boundaries and fail band; TF(deta) vs masym and vs m_avg in MC and data (A blinded); selection pair ranking on QCD MC over 6 variables; shifted-boundary validation regions
independence.result: masym x deta not independent at 10% level for the full masym>0.2 range (kappa 1.09, TF slope vs masym); restricting fail band to 0.2-0.4 gives kappa=1.008 (0.93-1.02 vs m_avg); TF(deta) rises strongly with m_avg (1.3->2.2) so TF is a fitted function of m_avg; data TF ~8% below MC TF in level, similar slope

tf.form: TF(m_avg)=N_B/N_D (deta<1.2 over deta>=1.2 in 0.2<=masym<0.4), non-QCD subtracted, quadratic polynomial in m_avg (order from F-test), applied to C(m_avg) per bin
tf.uncertainty: fit covariance (chi2/ndf of data fit 18.6/11); per-bin TF: in fits/prediction.json

other_backgrounds.method: W/Z+jets, ttbar, VV, H from MC (xsec*lumi) subtracted in B,C,D and added in A, 30% normalisation uncertainty varied coherently

validation_regions.definition: MC: y shifted: masym<0.2 / 0.2-0.4, 1.2<=deta<1.8 pass, >=1.8 fail

non_closure_syst.basis: max over MC closure, 3 MC VR, 3 data VR of |1-ratio| (if |pull|>2) else stat; data VR2/VR3 pulls -2.9/-3.0 give 1.6%; shape term = largest per-bin deviation in excess of uncertainty

n_events.note: data counts; A is the unblinded observed

checks_done: trigger turn-on vs HT and leading pT with 2 references
variable shape comparison QCD vs ttbar/VV proxies
pair ranking by kappa and chi2 vs m_avg in QCD MC
TF vs masym and m_avg in MC and data (blind)
checks_not_done: inverted-preselection sidebands (e.g. lepton or HT sideband)
JES/JER or PU reweighting of MC (MC only used for closure and non-QCD)
combine likelihood fit; no gaussian check of low-count bins beyond 350 GeV
notes: m_SD is soft-drop mass, no JMS/JMR correction; no signal sample so efficiency/optimisation is from QCD MC and ttbar/VV proxies only.
Observed/predicted agree (chi2 small = conservative systematics from shape terms taken from 7 tests).
Data TF is 8% below MC TF but ABCD is data-driven; MC only used for closure.
Open Data analysis: not an official CMS result.

plots.closure_mc_perbin: MC closure per m_avg bin with stat and frozen syst band
plots.closure_mc_variations: MC closure ratio under boundary, fail-band, HT-cut and TF-form variations
plots.validation_regions_data_perbin: three data validation regions per bin, obs/pred with bands
plots.design_2d_masym_deta: 2D masym vs |deta| in QCD MC and blinded data with region lines
plots.design_boundary_scan: kappa and proxy efficiencies vs each boundary, chosen values marked
plots.independence_ratio_vs_deta: masym pass/fail ratio vs |deta| in MC and data outside A
plots.substructure_dists: tau21, tau32, N2 of jets: QCD vs W/Z- and top-matched proxies
plots.substructure_roc: ROC of the substructure variables; not used (mass-dependent, untested as axes)
plots.closure_map_mc: inclusive kappa-1 and pull over a boundary grid, QCD MC, chosen point marked
plots.closure_map_data: same in data, only grid points whose test-A is outside SR A
plots.nonclosure_map: obs/pred-1 and pull per test and m_avg bin; boxes mark tests setting the shape term
